files.title: Add your bank files
files.intro: Download your transactions from your bank's website, then add the files here. You can add several at once.
files.supported: CSV, TXT, TSV, OFX and QFX files work.
files.unreadableHelp: On your bank's website, look for Export or Download and choose CSV, or OFX / QFX (sometimes called Quicken or Microsoft Money). Spreadsheet (XLSX) and PDF statements can't be read.
files.hintNoneReadable: Add a file that can be imported to continue.

account.title: Which account is this for?
account.intro: Every row of this file goes into one of your accounts.
account.introSeveral: This file has rows for more than one account. Choose where each of them goes.
account.noneInFile: The file doesn't say which account it is for
account.confirmPrompt: This is our best guess. Is it the right account?
account.openHint: Choose the account these transactions belong to, or create a new one.
account.openHintSeveral: Choose the account these rows belong to, create a new one, or leave these rows out.
account.hint: Choose or confirm the account to continue.

layout.title: Check how we read it
layout.intro: This is how the first rows of your file will be imported. If something looks wrong, change it below.
layout.fromSavedFormat: Read the same way as last time (“{{name}}”).
layout.fromSavedFormatOtherAccount: The columns are read as in “{{name}}”, a format saved for another account. Check which way the money goes in this one.
layout.fromFileType: This kind of file always has the same layout, so nothing had to be guessed.
layout.fromAi: This layout was suggested by AI. Check it carefully before you continue.
layout.missing: We could not find these in your file: {{parts}}. Choose the column for each under “Columns in your file”.
layout.previewTitle: How the first rows will be imported

dates.title: Dates
dates.label: Order of the date
dates.noneReadable: No date in this file can be read this way.
dates.noColumn: No date column is chosen yet.

decimal.title: Numbers
decimal.label: Decimal separator
decimal.noneReadable: No amount in this file can be read this way.

sign.title: Money in and money out
sign.exampleOut: “{{description}}” ({{raw}}) is read as money out: you paid {{amount}}.
sign.exampleIn: “{{description}}” ({{raw}}) is read as money in: you received {{amount}}.
sign.flip: No, it's the other way round
sign.fromColumns: Money out is read from “{{debit}}” and money in from “{{credit}}”.
sign.noAmount: No amount column is chosen yet.

layout.fixedColumns: This kind of file always uses the same columns, so there is nothing to choose here.
layout.columnsHelp: Each column of the file and what it is used for. Change one if we got it wrong.
layout.hintMissing: Choose the missing columns to continue.
layout.hintConfirm: Confirm the highlighted settings to continue.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.subtitle: Only if the columns above look wrong.
advanced.headerNone: This file was read without column names.
advanced.noHeader: The file has no column names
advanced.failed: The file could not be read with these settings.

ai.offer: Not sure about this layout? {{provider}} can suggest one.

outcome.applied: The AI's suggestion is shown below. Check it before you continue.
outcome.noAnswer: The AI could not work out this file. Choose the columns yourself below.
outcome.failed: The AI could not be reached. Choose the columns yourself below.

ai.consentBody: To suggest a layout, the column names and the rows below are sent to {{provider}}. Long numbers are shortened to their last four digits. Nothing else leaves this device.

review.title: Things to check
review.intro: What we noticed while reading your file. Nothing has been imported yet.
review.blocked: Some things need a decision before this file can be imported.
review.clearWithWarnings_one: Nothing stops this import. {{count}} thing is worth a look.
review.clearWithWarnings_other: Nothing stops this import. {{count}} things are worth a look.
review.checking: Checking for rows that are already imported, repeated rows and transfers…
review.checkFailed: The rows could not be checked against what is already imported.

duplicates.title: Rows that appear more than once
duplicates.help: Every copy is imported unless you untick it. Two coffees on the same day are two rows; a line the bank repeated is one.

transfers.title: Transfers between your accounts
transfers.help: A ticked pair is imported as a transfer, so it counts as neither income nor spending. Untick a pair to import both rows as they are.

coverage.title: Compared with what is already imported
coverage.stored_one: This account already has {{count}} transaction, from {{from}} to {{to}}.
coverage.stored_other: This account already has {{count}} transactions, from {{from}} to {{to}}.
coverage.none: Nothing has been imported into this account yet.

review.hint: Fix or leave out the rows that can't be read to continue.

blockers.blockedRows_one: {{count}} row can't be read. Fix it or leave it out.
blockers.blockedRows_other: {{count}} rows can't be read. Fix them or leave them out.
blockers.confirm: Confirm how the file is read.
blockers.noRows: There is nothing left to import in this file.

summary.title: Summary
summary.sameFormat: Same format as last time (“{{name}}”). Nothing needs your attention.
summary.failed: The import did not go through, and nothing was changed. {{error}}
summary.nothingNew_one: The {{count}} row in this file is already imported. There is nothing new to add.
summary.nothingNew_other: All {{count}} rows in this file are already imported. There is nothing new to add.
summary.nothingLeft: There is nothing left to import in this file.
summary.rememberHelp: Next time, a file like this one goes straight to this summary.
summary.rememberHelpKnown: Keeps the saved format up to date with any change you made.

done.title: Import finished
done.duplicates_one: {{count}} row was already imported and was left out
done.duplicates_other: {{count}} rows were already imported and were left out
done.undoHelp: Changed your mind? An import can be undone from History & formats.

leave.title: Discard this import?
leave.body: The files you added have not been imported yet.
leave.bodyPartly_one: {{count}} file is already imported and stays imported. The rest has not been imported yet.
leave.bodyPartly_other: {{count}} files are already imported and stay imported. The rest has not been imported yet.
